turn: Alert delivery via webhooks now retries failed sends with exponential backoff. The new `sendWithRetry` in `src/webhook/retry.ts` wraps `sendAlert`, makes up to 6 attempts, and waits 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s and 16s between them. If the last attempt fails, it rethrows that error so the caller can see it. I checked this by reading through the retry loop, including the attempt counting and the point where it gives up. I didn't run it against a live endpoint or write automated tests for it, so the timing and the final rethrow are untested. In the same commit I made one small unrelated fix. The webhook sender was building its headers object in a way that could drop a caller-supplied Content-Type, and it now keeps that value. Next I'll start "Cache for firmware manifests".

sidefix.title: Preserve caller-supplied Content-Type header
sidefix.what: The webhook sender no longer drops a Content-Type header supplied by the caller when it builds the request headers.
